summary: MaintCourseDetailsASM control is used for maintaining course details. It includes functionality for editing course details, selecting associated services, and handling permissions for viewing and editing course information.
purpose: To maintain course details and associated service settings.

workflows.name: Maintain Course Details
steps: Enter edit mode to modify course

business_rules: Course details can be modified only when ScreenIsEditable is true
validations: Ensure the UserSession is active before data operations
conditions: Screen must be editable to modify data
system_behavior: Displays course data and associated services
